get.description: Read a page of objects of a specified type in your HubSpot account. You can control the data returned by specifying the properties, associations, and archived status through query parameters. This endpoint is useful for retrieving a list of CRM objects with specific details.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

parameters.name: associations
parameters.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

parameters.name: propertiesWithHistory
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored. Usage of this parameter will reduce the maximum number of objects that can be read by a single request.

post.description: Create a CRM object with the specified properties and receive a copy of the object, including its ID. This endpoint is useful for adding new records to your CRM system. Ensure that all necessary properties are included in the request body as per the documentation for standard objects.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

post.description: Archive a batch of CRM objects by their IDs. This endpoint allows you to move multiple objects of a specified type to the recycling bin in a single request. It is useful for efficiently managing and organizing large sets of data by removing unnecessary or outdated records.

Create a batch of CRM objects with specified properties in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows for the creation of multiple objects in a single request, returning a copy of each object including their IDs. It is useful for efficiently adding large numbers of objects at once.

Read a batch of CRM objects by their internal IDs or unique property values. This endpoint allows you to retrieve multiple objects in a single request, which can be useful for efficiently gathering data for a set of objects. You can specify whether to include archived objects in the response.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

post.description: Update a batch of CRM objects in HubSpot by specifying the object type and providing the necessary data in the request body. This endpoint is useful for making bulk updates to objects, such as contacts or deals, in a single API call. It supports updating multiple objects simultaneously, streamlining the process of data management within your CRM.

Create or update a batch of CRM objects by unique property values. This endpoint allows you to efficiently manage large sets of objects by either inserting new ones or updating existing ones based on their unique properties.

Permanently delete a contact and all associated content to comply with GDPR regulations. This endpoint allows you to specify the contact using an optional 'idProperty' set to 'email' to identify the contact by their email address. If the email address is not found, it will be added to a blocklist to prevent future usage.

Merge two CRM objects of the same type into one. This operation is useful when you need to consolidate duplicate records or unify data under a single object. The endpoint requires specifying which object should be the primary one after the merge.

Search for CRM objects of a specified type using the provided search criteria. This endpoint allows you to filter and sort the results based on various properties and conditions. It is useful for retrieving specific objects that match your search parameters.

get.description: Read an object identified by `objectId`. This endpoint allows you to retrieve details of a specific CRM object using its ID or any unique property value specified by the `idProperty` query parameter. You can control the data returned by specifying desired properties through the `properties` query parameter.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

parameters.name: associations
parameters.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

parameters.name: idProperty
parameters.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

parameters.name: propertiesWithHistory
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

delete.description: Move an Object identified by `{objectId}` to the recycling bin. This operation allows you to archive a specific CRM object based on its unique identifier, effectively removing it from active use while retaining the option to restore it later if needed.

patch.description: Perform a partial update of an object identified by `{objectId}`. By default, `{objectId}` refers to the internal object ID, but you can specify any unique property value using the `idProperty` query parameter. The provided property values will overwrite existing ones, while read-only and non-existent properties will be ignored. To clear a property value, pass an empty string.

parameters.name: idProperty
parameters.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type

get.description: List all associations of a specified object by its type. This endpoint allows you to retrieve associations for a given object type and object ID, with a limit of 500 associations per call. It is useful for understanding the relationships and connections between different CRM objects.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.
